verdict.rationale: The docs show several data products (account owner/identity, balances, transactions, ACH details) that each work against an account connected through Connect. That implies one linked account can serve multiple products, but the docs never explicitly say so. missing for 10: explicit documentation that one Connect session grants access to all products without re-linking, details on product/permission scoping at link time, and hands-on or independent confirmation of the single-flow experience.
